mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material (material_name, material_type, course_id, uploader_id, file_url, file_size, download_score, download_count, description, status, keyword, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{materialName}, #{materialType}, #{courseId}, #{uploaderId}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{downloadScore}, #{downloadCount}, #{description}, #{status}, #{keyword}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE material SET download_count = download_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
UPDATE material SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT material_type AS category_id, material_type AS category_name FROM material WHERE is_deleted = 0
